name: 価格と人気条件と並べ替えの絞り込み
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse LH01-0086 価格と人気条件と並べ替えの絞り込み. Input1 original full source controls visible selected states/apply count. Inputs2/3/4 original price/popular/sort crops control exact control geometry. Input5 native mock controls Japanese text and THREE-section composition. Do not include source modal Close/Filters/Reset header or otherOffering/Meal sections.
Purewhite#FFFFFF compact vertical panel. Section headings "価格帯", "人気の条件", "並べ替え", Meiryo Bold70020/28-equivalent tracking0. ALL other labels Meiryo REGULAR40014/24 tracking0, no blanket bold. Fine neutral dividers between sections, comfortable compact rows.
価格帯: four equal horizontal white pills, labels "手頃", "標準", "上質", "特別". FIRST TWO selected with stronger2px forestgreen#1F6444 outlines/green text, white interior; lasttwo neutral1px outlines/dark labels. Retain source two-price selection, no tintedcyan/mint fill, added checkmarks or dollar signs.
人気の条件: EXACT four left labels with right-aligned source rounded-square checkboxes: "新しくできた施設"; "配達に対応"; "持ち帰りに対応"; "営業中". ALL FOUR CHECKBOXES EMPTY/UNCHECKED, white with fine neutral outlines. Original state overrides mock's erroneous first check. No checkmark/filled square in this section.
並べ替え: EXACT four left labels with right-aligned source circle radios: "おすすめ順"; "距離が近い順"; "評価が高い順"; "口コミが多い順". ONLY おすすめ順 selected with forestgreen outlined circle and filled inner dot; other3 circles white neutral outline. Preserve radio vs checkbox shapes and align right column across rows.
Bottom full-width primary pill button, smooth restrained135deg forestgreen gradient#174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, white REGULAR40014/24 label EXACT "条件を適用（2件）". Count2 is source snapshot, no invented extra selections/count3. Gentle edge light/tiny shadow, no glossy neon.
Keep all text/controls complete, readable and unclipped, modest outside margins, no oversized empty space. No photos, icons beyond controls, extra conditions, enclosing card, phone frame or backgroundscene. Static raster candidate only; filtering/counting/reset/selection/keyboard behavior unverified.
reviewNotes: Correct two-price selection, all4popular unchecked, firstsort selected and count2; Japanese copy complete, white controls and green primary. Four price labels and apply label became bold rather than Regular; headings correctly bold. Needs label-weight-only correction, raster candidate only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
